title: Make the optimizer easy to use and integrate
description:
## Scope

Ship a small offline walkthrough and explicit live interfaces around the native, provider-neutral Decision Flywheel optimizer. Do not add DSPy dependencies, bridges, or optimization paths.

## Definition of done

Documented local workflow, reproducible fixtures, release-ready package, and evidence links for native optimization; no optional DSPy integration is in scope.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Accountability: this was an assistant-authored scope error, not a stale external requirement. DSPy is explicitly excluded; the epic now covers only native, provider-neutral optimization.
